catalysts.headline: Connect Biopharma shares rose ~24.6% to $1.235 after announcing positive Phase 2 COPD trial results for rademikibart
catalysts.impact: Large single-day stock move (volume ~150M shares vs ~1.03M average) on positive topline Phase 2 COPD data

catalysts.headline: Positive preliminary topline data from global Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT COPD study of rademikibart as add-on treatment for acute exacerbations: treatment failure cut 81% through Week 4 vs. placebo (p=0.0122, primary endpoint met); new moderate-to-severe exacerbations cut 85% (p=0.030); FEV1 improvement of 70 mL not statistically significant (p=0.1607); no new safety signals; company to engage FDA on potential Phase 3 program
catalysts.impact: stock reported up ~24.6% in follow-on coverage

catalysts.headline: Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT COPD topline for rademikibart (add-on to standard of care, 159 patients): reduced treatment-failure rate by 81% (p=0.0122) and reduced new moderate-to-severe exacerbations by 85% (p=0.030) vs. placebo; missed a secondary FEV1 (lung-function) endpoint
catalysts.note: Exact release date not independently pinned down (reported via secondary coverage, not the primary press release); 'early October 2026' is the best-supported window

catalysts.headline: Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT asthma topline for rademikibart (acute exacerbations): reduced 28-day treatment-failure rate by 66% vs placebo but did not reach statistical significance; secondary endpoint post-bronchodilator FEV1 showed a statistically significant improvement vs baseline
catalysts.impact: Stock fell sharply (-26% to -40% premarket per contemporaneous reports) on the primary-endpoint miss

catalysts.headline: Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT asthma topline for rademikibart (acute exacerbations): reduced 28-day treatment-failure rate by 66% vs placebo but did not reach statistical significance (company cited lower-than-projected overall treatment-failure rate); secondary endpoint post-bronchodilator FEV1 showed a statistically significant improvement vs baseline.
catalysts.impact: Stock described as having fallen sharply on the miss
catalysts.note: Exact release date could not be independently confirmed in this sandbox (source article undated in search snippet); company had guided in a 2026-06-17 release to 'early September 2026' for this readout, consistent with the on-file 2026-09-16 date, which is retained here.

catalysts.headline: Positive preliminary Phase 2 topline data for rademikibart in acute asthma exacerbations -- statistically significant FEV1 improvement at Day 7 vs placebo and ~66% reduction in 28-day treatment failures (the treatment-failure endpoint itself did not reach statistical significance; safety profile was clean)

Lead candidate rademikibart failed to meet the primary endpoint in a Phase 2 asthma trial; the company's own release emphasized positive secondary findings (66% reduction in treatment failure, FEV1 improvement), but the stock reaction indicates the primary-endpoint miss dominated investor reaction
catalysts.impact: -26% to -40% premarket (day range $0.91-$1.82 per one source)

catalysts.headline: Company press release set expected timing: Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT asthma topline in early September 2026, with Phase 2 COPD companion study topline to follow
Company press release set expected timing: Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT asthma topline in early September 2026, with Phase 2 COPD companion study topline to follow soon after
